verbs: Trying platform nine and three quarters

tips: Always bow before approaching a Hippogriff, and wait for it to bow back.
Always say 'Mischief managed' when you're done with the Marauders' Map.
Always wear earmuffs when repotting Mandrakes.
Ask the staircases nicely. They like to change.
Avoid Moaning Myrtle's bathroom unless you're brewing something illegal.
Constant vigilance!
Dobby is a free elf. Give socks generously.
Don't go into the Forbidden Forest. It's forbidden.
Don't say his name. Say 'You-Know-Who'.
Help will always be given at Hogwarts to those who ask for it.
It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
It's Levi-O-sa, not Levio-SA.
Keep your jewelry locked up, especially if there's a Niffler around.
Keep your wand in your hand, not in your back pocket. Better wizards than you have lost buttocks.
Never brew Polyjuice Potion with cat hair.
Never trust anything that can think for itself if you can't see where it keeps its brain.
Owls deliver at breakfast. Keep your bacon covered.
Tell the Fat Lady the password before she starts singing.
The Room of Requirement appears when you really need it. Walk past three times.
Walk straight at the wall between platforms nine and ten. Best do it at a bit of a run if you're nervous.
When Bertie Bott's Every Flavor Beans say every flavor, they *mean* every flavor.
